checks.why: a callable handed over as a VALUE — Depends(provider) — is called by the framework and by no call site the graph can see. The row naming the callable that hands it over already existed; what did not was the closure continuing from there, so the answer named create_order and then said the closure could not start, and the test that drives create_order was never reached
the same when the value is an argument to a queue rather than a default
a declaration handed to nobody reaches only its own test: the seed is the VALUE REFERENCE, not the name
